what: Only the chosen cover stands front and center (z 150px · 0°), and side covers sit o×35 + 100px to the side (phone o×25 + 60) by their distance o from the chosen one, recede |o|×50px back, turn 60° outward and darken to .45 brightness (220px · phone 150px). Moving by arrow, tapping a side cover, ←→ keys or dragging sideways past 40px slides all covers to new spots over .65s power3.out, wrapping around by the nearest side. On fx:layout "arc" On sending, covers 380px wide are fanned out along an arc of 1000px radius (480 on phone) at 22° per slot (28° on phone), the chosen one at 1.08x and the rest at .88x · "ring" Back covers circle along an elliptical orbit (horizontal radius .38~.40 of screen width · depth .42x of that, height sin(2θ)·65) continuously, the ones in front stand at 1.14x and darker. On entry each frame whips round at .14rad, then slows by .985 steps of .0006 while the radius expands over .9s power2.out. By the cursor’s horizontal position the covers turn to look ±18° and float ±20px vertically, dragging rotates them .008rad per 1px · "balls" Cover tiles (185px at 1600px and up · 165 at 1360 · 135 at 1000 · 100px below that) pop up 12~15px per frame around the chosen cell (spreading .22rad per cell), fall with gravity .26 · air .99, bounce off each other, the walls and the floor (stage center to 46% of the screen − 40px) at .68, slide on the floor and settle. When the cursor comes within radius (size .52x) + 30px they are pushed away, and a hovered cover stops in place and stands forward at 1.5x · with auto, one cell advances by itself every that many seconds

options.look: Initial type — fan (default) · arc · ring · balls
options.phone: Width for switching to phone size (px), default 768
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Marker (required) — is-fx-active on the chosen one
options.[data-fx-part=media]: (If any) image inside the cover — brightness changes
options.fx:layout · fx:pick: On the board "fan"·"arc"·"ring"·"balls" Send as detail to change the type · when the selected cell changes, detail { index }
options.auto: Interval in seconds for auto-advancing one slot in carousel types (fan, arc), default 0 (off) — original 2. Manual navigation restarts the timer

use: …
